mapper.select: SELECT subject_key_version FROM mk_referral_subject_index_anchor WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_join_command(tenant_id,subject_key,idempotency_key,request_hash,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{subjectKey},#{key},#{requestHash},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE row_version=row_version
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash AS requestHash,participant_id AS participantId FROM mk_referral_join_command WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND subject_key=#{subjectKey} AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_subject_role(tenant_id,campaign_id,subject_key,subject_key_version,role,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{campaign},#{subjectKey},#{keyVersion},'INVITER',#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE row_version=row_version
mapper.select: SELECT role,participant_id AS participantId,subject_key_version AS keyVersion FROM mk_referral_subject_role WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND campaign_id=#{campaign} AND subject_key=#{subjectKey} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId,participant_id AS participantId,campaign_id AS campaignId,organization_id AS organizationId,shop_id AS shopId, definition_id AS definitionId,definition_version AS definitionVersion,generation,artifact_id AS artifactId,policy_hash AS policyHash, route_epoch AS routeEpoch,state,created_at AS createdAt FROM mk_referral_participant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND participant_id=#{participantId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_referral_subject_role SET participant_id=#{p.participantId},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND campaign_id=#{p.campaignId} AND subject_key=#{subjectKey} AND role='INVITER' AND participant_id IS NULL

UPDATE mk_referral_join_command SET participant_id=#{participantId},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND subject_key=#{subjectKey} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND participant_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_audit(tenant_id,audit_id,actor_id,action,resource_ref,reason,after_hash,trace_id,occurred_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{p.tenantId},#{auditId},#{actorId},'PARTICIPANT_JOINED',#{p.participantId},'首次固定活动版本',#{payloadHash},#{traceId},#{now},#{now},#{now})
